data.text: The LORD reigns, clothed in majesty; the LORD is clothed in strength and has girded himself. Indeed, the world stands firm; it will not be shaken.
Your throne stands firm from long ago; you are from everlasting.
The floods have risen, LORD; the floods have lifted their voice; the floods lift their waves.
Mightier than the roar of many waters, than the mighty breakers of the sea, is the LORD on high.
Your testimonies are utterly trustworthy; holiness befits your house, LORD, for all days to come.
